title: Slushie Bar Xtra Blue Pear Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Blue Pear Ice delivers a perfectly balanced blend of fresh, juicy Pear, and sweet and tangy Blue Raspberry with a refreshing menthol breeze. This e-liquid combines the naturally crisp and mellow sweetness of ripe pears with dash of Blue Raspberry slushy flavour and a frosty finish that’s as cooling as it is satisfying. Ideal for vapers who enjoy fruit-inspired blends with a cool, slushy twist, Blue Pear Ice offers a clean and refreshing vape that can be enjoyed all day long. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
